{{Top|leg}}
'''Delios''' was a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who operated out of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial-controlled]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Delios benefited from the policies of [[Sean Trenwell]], the [[Director of Commerce]] for the city.<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempArtisan.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Delios]]
Delios was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />

Delios and the other four merchants would populate the Bestine marketplace whenever Sean Trenwell was in office. Because the Bestine merchants were dynamically generated, their [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[Gender/Legends|gender]] were randomized during each server reset. However, their names were always consistent.<ref name="AED" />
